fact: The Central Bank of Liberia's Mobile Money Regulations are described as the regulatory framework governing electronic money and mobile-money operators in Liberia, with more than 11 million mobile wallets operating; the document gives no date for the regulations, so its 2024 published date (a year-level proxy) is used.
